name: pl.obligacyjnyinwestor/obligacje-catalyst
title: Obligacje Catalyst (Obligacyjny Inwestor)
description: GPW Catalyst corporate bonds: series, coupons, covenants, yield calculator; ETFs listed on GPW.

tools.name: search_issuers
tools.description: Find issuers of corporate bonds listed on GPW Catalyst (Poland) by name, ticker prefix or sector. Returns name, sector, number of listed series, next maturity and the source page. Szukanie emitentów obligacji korporacyjnych z Catalyst.

query.description: Issuer name, short name or part of it, e.g. "Kruk". Empty = list all.

sector.description: Optional sector filter (Polish label fragment), e.g. "Deweloperzy".

tools.name: get_issuer_bonds
tools.description: List all bond series of one issuer listed on GPW Catalyst: code, maturity date, issue value, coupon type, base rate, margin, current coupon. Serie obligacji jednego emitenta z terminami wykupu i oprocentowaniem.

issuer.description: Issuer name, id from search_issuers, or any bond code of that issuer (e.g. "KRU1226").

tools.name: get_bond
tools.description: Details of one Catalyst bond series by its code (e.g. "KRU1226"): ISIN, issuer, maturity, coupon terms, collateral, issue value, upcoming interest payment dates and the financial covenant from the terms of issue with a quote and source document, plus data_quality per field (confirmed by a document, to verify, missing). Szczegóły serii: parametry, terminy odsetek, kowenant, jakość danych.

code.description: Catalyst code of the series, e.g. "KRU1226".

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Calendar of the Catalyst corporate bond market for a date range: maturities (redemptions), interest payments and open public offers. Default range: next 30 days; maximum 366 days and 100 rows per call. Kalendarz wykupów, wypłat odsetek i zapisów na emisje.

issuer.description: Optional issuer name or id to filter by.

tools.name: search_etfs
tools.description: List of all ETFs, ETCs and ETNs listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (GPW), with asset class, index, ongoing cost (TER) from the KID, distribution policy, replication and provider, each with a link to the KID. Filters: name/ticker/ISIN, asset class (equity, government bonds, corporate bonds, commodities, crypto), type, provider, maximum cost. listing="outside_gpw" lists selected large corporate bond UCITS ETFs not listed on GPW (there is no corporate bond ETF on GPW). No prices or yields. Lista ETF/ETC/ETN z GPW z kosztem, indeksem i replikacją.

query.description: Part of name, ticker, ISIN, index or provider, e.g. "WIG20", "Beta", "S&P 500".

asset_class.description: equity, government bonds, corporate bonds, bonds (all bond classes), commodities, crypto. Polish labels also accepted.

max_cost.description: Maximum ongoing cost in % per year, e.g. "0.5".

listing.description: gpw (default) = listed on GPW; outside_gpw = selected corporate bond ETFs listed abroad; all = both.

tools.name: get_etf
tools.description: Details of one ETF/ETC/ETN by ticker or ISIN (e.g. "ETFBTBSP", "PLBTBSP00012", "IEAC"): index, ongoing cost, distribution, replication, base currency, currency hedging, first listing date, fund assets, legal form, domicile, launch date, KID; for bond ETFs also duration, number of bonds, fund assets, average rating, high yield share, tracking difference by year and portfolio breakdown by sector, country and rating. Each value has its source, date and quality (confirmed, to_verify with a note, missing with a reason). Szczegóły jednego ETF.

tools.name: calculate_yield
tools.description: What-if calculator for one Catalyst bond series. Give the series code and EITHER a clean price you saw at your broker (price_pct, % of face value, e.g. "101.5") OR a yield (yield_pct, % per year, annual effective) and get: accrued interest, dirty price, yield to maturity (annual effective and compounded per coupon period), current yield, duration for fixed-rate bonds and an approximate effective margin for floating-rate bonds. Uses our coupon terms and the current coupon (for floating-rate bonds the current coupon is assumed to stay until maturity); before tax and fees; early redemption and amortisation are not modelled. We publish no market prices: the price must come from the user. Kalkulator: rentowność z ceny albo cena z rentowności, odsetki narosłe, cena brudna.

code.description: Catalyst code of the series, e.g. "KRU0632".

price_pct.description: Clean price in % of face value (without accrued interest), as quoted on Catalyst, e.g. "101.5". Give this or yield_pct.

yield_pct.description: Yield to maturity in % per year (annual effective, ACT/365), e.g. "7.2". Give this or price_pct.

settlement_date.description: Settlement date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today + 2 business days, the Catalyst T+2 rule).

face_value.description: Optional face value of one bond in its currency (e.g. "100" or "1000") to also get amounts per bond.

tools.name: report_gap
tools.description: Tell the editors of obligacyjnyinwestor.pl about a problem with this server: missing data, a value that looks wrong, a tool or field you needed but could not find, or a confusing tool description. Use it at most once per problem in a conversation. Describe only the data problem: no personal data and no copy of the user's conversation. Only a confirmation is returned; no reply is sent. Zgłoszenie braku albo błędu w danych.

description.description: What is missing or wrong, in English or Polish, max 500 characters. Include the expected value and its source if you know them.

tool.description: Optional: tool the problem concerns, e.g. "get_bond".

code.description: Optional: series code or issuer id the problem concerns.

tools.name: request_bond
tools.description: Ask the editors to add a bond series listed on GPW Catalyst that get_bond did not find. Call it only after the user agrees. If the series is already in our data, the tool says so and records nothing. Only a confirmation is returned. Prośba o dodanie serii z Catalyst, której nie mamy.

code.description: Catalyst code (e.g. "ABC0528") or ISIN (e.g. "PLABC0000123") of the series.

note.description: Optional short note, e.g. where the user saw the series (max 200 characters).

tools.name: screen_bonds
tools.description: Screen all corporate bond series listed on GPW Catalyst by their terms: margin, current coupon, maturity range, fixed or floating coupon, base rate, currency, collateral, minimum issue value, financial covenant in our data, sector or issuer. Returns compact rows (code, issuer, maturity, margin, coupon, collateral, covenant flag, source), sorted by maturity by default. No market prices or yields. Wyszukiwarka serii obligacji po parametrach.

min_margin_pct.description: Minimum margin over the base rate, % per year, e.g. "4".

base_rate.description: Base rate of floating coupons, e.g. "WIBOR 3M", "WIBOR 6M", "EURIBOR".

collateral.description: secured = any collateral; none = unsecured; or one kind.

min_issue_value.description: Minimum issue value in the series currency, e.g. "50000000".

financial_covenant.description: yes = a financial covenant from the terms of issue is in our data.

sector.description: Sector (Polish or English label fragment), e.g. "Deweloperzy", "debt collection".

issuer.description: Issuer name or part of it.

tools.name: portfolio_cashflows
tools.description: Cash flow plan for bonds the user holds: give series codes with the face value held and get coupons and redemptions month by month for up to 120 months, before and after the 19% tax (or another rate, e.g. 0 for IKE/IKZE), totals per currency and each payment. Floating coupons after the current period assume the current rate stays. Nothing is stored. Plan wpływów z obligacji: kupony i wykupy miesiąc po miesiącu.

holdings.description: Up to 20 positions separated by commas: "CODE:FACE_VALUE_HELD" or "CODE:QUANTITY@FACE_VALUE_OF_ONE_BOND", e.g. "KRU0632:10000, ECO1028:5@1000". Ask the user for the face value of one bond if unsure (often 100 or 1000).

tax_pct.description: Tax on interest in % (default 19, the Polish flat tax; 0 for IKE/IKZE).

tools.name: compare_with_treasury
tools.description: Compare one PLN Catalyst series held to maturity with each Polish retail treasury savings bond of the current offer (OTS, ROR, DOR, TOS, COI, EDO, ROS, ROD) held to its maturity: amount invested, interest, tax, net payout, gross and net annual yield, with the series closest in term marked. Treasury rates after the first period depend on inflation and the NBP rate: they are assumptions (defaults given, user can change them). Corporate price comes from the user (100% assumed if not given). Descriptive calculation, not advice. Porównanie serii z obligacjami skarbowymi po podatku.

code.description: Catalyst code of a PLN series, e.g. "KRU0632".

price_pct.description: Clean price of the corporate series in % of face value, from the user (default 100, stated as an assumption).

inflation_pct.description: Assumed yearly inflation for inflation-linked treasury bonds from year 2, % (default: last GUS reading used by our calculator).

nbp_rate_pct.description: Assumed NBP reference rate for ROR/DOR, % (default: current rate).

account.description: regular = 19% tax on interest (default); ike = IKE/IKZE, no tax on interest.
